nodes.label: Rundale Agricultural System
nodes.evidence_status: Rundale, loy, lazy-bed, conacre, and meitheal claims verified; St Patrick's Day planting date remains unverified.
nodes.rationale: Communally redistributed strips, common grazing, spade cultivation, and lazy beds adapted subsistence farming to narrow holdings and wet soils.

nodes.label: Potato and Conacre Precarity
nodes.rationale: High-yield Lumpers and seasonal conacre access sustained land-poor families while concentrating risk and denying tenure security.

nodes.label: Seasonal Farming Calendar
nodes.rationale: Planting, turf cutting, fairs, harvest meitheal, and winter craft work provide a seasonal backbone for NPC schedules and communal events.
